create_contact: create a new Contact dataclass instance with first name, last name, gender, age, and phone number
add_new_contact: add a new contact to the ContactsApp with first name, last name, email, and phone fields
search_contacts: search contacts by partial match on first name, last name, phone number, or email address
edit_contact: edit specific fields of an existing contact by contact_id using a dictionary of updates
get_contacts: get a paginated list of contacts from ContactsApp starting from a specified offset with view limit
